thread:
Maya K.: Heads-up: PR #2487 updates tokenizer dependency and touches runtime KV fallback. Need security + infra + runtime eyes before I merge tomorrow. TL;DR: bump tokenizers -> 0.13.1, fix a race in kv cache init, adds a small change to runtime config default batch_timeout.

Sunil R.: @Maya K. can you paste the PR link and a quick checklist of potential risk areas? :thumbsup:

Maya K.: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/2487
Checklist:
- tokenizers update (C lib) -> may affect binary dist
- kv cache init: added atomic flag to avoid double-init
- runtime default: batch_timeout from 10ms -> 5ms (can impact perf)
- added a new optional env REDWOOD_SAFE_MODE
I ran unit tests, integration staging run in eu-west3 for 2 hours.

Hiro T.: I'll take runtime review. I want to run a perf smoke locally — can you add a short dockerfile to reproduce or a command?

Maya K.: added a quick `scripts/perf-smoke.sh` to the PR + howto in the PR description.

Lisa (security): tagging security: Quick glance: tokenizers native update is the main signal. Do you have SBOM and Sigstore attestations? Any new transitive deps?

Maya K.: SBOM attached in PR, sigstore not yet (need CI key). No new transitive native deps, just a patch of lib-tokenizer small C change.

Owen: infra: will this require changing packaging for Dedicated nodes? If we need to ship new wheels with the C lib we should coordinate with release.

Maya K.: yes, we need new manylinux wheel. plan: build on buildfarm -> push to internal pip index; can schedule for next maintenance window Wed 02:00 UTC.

InfraBot: scheduled build job `build-wheel-2487` queued (est start: 1713520000).

Hiro T.: runtime: looked at kv-change, LGTM apart from one nit in the locking. Will drop an inline comment.

Lisa (security): I'll do a quick review tonight and request sigstore CI; cc @sec-sre.

Sunil R.: sounds good. Maya, once infra builds wheel and security signs off, do you need platform to flip any runtime flags?

Maya K.: platform: just a toggle to enable REDWOOD_SAFE_MODE default=false — no rollout needed. @Owen please confirm.

Owen: can flip the flag in canary first, will coordinate with ops.

Maya K.: Thanks all — aiming to merge tomorrow 09:00 PT if no blockers. :raised_hands:
